semanticDifferences: Selection state lives on the group (value/defaultValue/onValueChange(value, eventDetails)); Radio contributes only its value — React Aria also allowed a per-item isSelected, which the migration folds into the group value from the children
value is a single value, not an array
Parts are Root/Indicator; state attributes are data-checked/data-unchecked, data-disabled
Renders role=radio (nativeButton default true), matching React Aria's single-select ToggleButtonGroup
Value is always an array, even when multiple is false, and selection switches behaviour with `multiple`
No data-selected on the group; each Toggle owns its state
State attribute is data-pressed (React Aria emitted data-selected)

migrationRecord.existingUntitledUiBehavior: single-select mode renders radio semantics (role=radiogroup with role=radio children, aria-checked); multiple mode renders pressed toggles; items support controlled isSelected (pagination), uncontrolled defaultSelected, ids, disabled, leading/trailing icons and per-size class vocabulary
migrationRecord.canonicalBehavioralContract: single selection = radio group semantics and arrow-key navigation; multiple selection = pressed toggles; group-level controlled/uncontrolled selection in React Aria's Selection vocabulary plus per-item controlled state
migrationRecord.baseUiCompositionChosen: RadioGroup + Radio for single selection (explicit radio semantics, selection on the group), ToggleGroup + Toggle for multiple selection; a narrow child-derived adapter folds per-item isSelected into the group value
migrationRecord.whyNotOneToOne: React Aria's ToggleButtonGroup is one primitive that switches semantics by selectionMode; Base UI splits radio and toggle families, and its ToggleGroup in single mode does not emit aria-checked (verified in this harness), so the radio family is the faithful target rather than a renamed ToggleGroup

publicApiChanges.reason: Base UI's Toggle/ToggleGroup type their value as string; the group identifies items by string
publicApiChanges.migrationNote: Numeric ids now fail at compile time instead of being silently coerced at runtime. No payload consumer passes numeric ids (pagination passes none).
publicApiChanges.compatibility: compile-time narrowing, no runtime behaviour change observed in the payload

publicApiChanges.reason: Base UI has no "all" concept for a toggle/radio group
publicApiChanges.migrationNote: A group cannot express select-all; pass explicit ids instead.
publicApiChanges.compatibility: edge case; no payload consumer uses "all"

stateSelectorChanges.reason: Base UI's toggle emits data-pressed; the react-aria-components Tailwind plugin's `selected:` variant resolves to [data-selected], which Base UI never emits
same attribute rename, scoped to the item as the group parent
